template.name: Bullish & Bearish Harami Stochastic
template.entry_long: high <= donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and low >= donchian_low_prev(low,{p1}) and close > open and rsi(close,{p2}) < {p0}
template.notes: The harami is expressed as an inside bullish body (current range within the prior bar) with the documented OversoldLevel 30 confirmation and the 20/80 ExitLower/ExitUpper thresholds close the trade. Stochastic %K/%D and the 47/9/13 smoothings are unavailable, so RSI(14) stands in for %D and the MovingAveragePeriod=5 body filter is not represented.
